Cedar Vale Systems Ltd. - FY2026 Operations Update
Research marker: 🌍.
Revenue was USD 12 million.
The rollout is constrained by a shortage of high-voltage transformers.

Cedar Vale Systems Ltd. - FY2026 Corrected Operations Update
Research marker: 🌍.
Revenue was USD 14 million.
The rollout is constrained by a shortage of high-voltage transformers.

cases.arrangement: Two concurrent captures in one workspace use the same request key and canonical input.
cases.action: Retry after one accepted response is lost.
expected: One committed capture, original owner, processing run, and initial outbox event.
Every successful replay returns the same capture identifiers.
An uncertain commit never causes compensation of a committed original.

cases.arrangement: Version-1 bytes were captured under a committed request key.
cases.action: Submit version-2 bytes under the same scoped operation and key.
expected: 409 CONFLICT; no second capture or event; original remains unchanged.

cases.arrangement: Version-1 original already exists in the workspace.
cases.action: Import the identical canonical bytes using a separate key and document identity.
expected: Two independent originals and archive items; one scoped duplicate relation.
The same bytes in another workspace expose no duplicate or shared object.

cases.arrangement: Version 1 is active and has a retained accepted answer citing its revenue sentence.
cases.action: Capture version 2, delay indexing, then promote its complete derived output.
expected: New research uses version 1 while version 2 is pending.
A failed candidate cannot change the active version or chunk set.
Successful promotion exposes version 2 without mixed old/new context.
The old answer-bound historical view opens exactly the version-1 sentence and bytes.
Ordinary current-source endpoints still refuse inactive version 1.

cases.arrangement: One manifest contains two valid fixture PDF parts and one invalid-signature part, within global limits.
cases.action: Admit items, lose the response, and retry each item with its original key.
expected: Two accepted item results and one safe rejected result; accepted siblings remain.
Retry does not multiply the two accepted captures.
A separate globally oversized or malformed envelope commits no item.

cases.arrangement: Capture committed its processing run and outbox event while Redis is unavailable.
cases.action: Restore Redis; separately lose a published task before any worker claim and run due repair.
expected: Known broker unavailability leaves durable intent and consumes no processing attempt.
A later tick recovers ordinary outage and the published-but-lost task within policy.
Repeated publication has one canonical effect; receipts do not imply readiness.
Exhausted delivery allowance becomes visible blocked work, never success or a reset loop.

cases.arrangement: One attempt claimed parse/lexical work and stopped before committing its output.
cases.action: Reject a competing live claim; reclaim after expiry; let the stale worker try to finish.
expected: Only the current owner can commit blocks, chunks, and stage completion.
Completed parse/lexical output is not repeated when indexing alone retries.
Attempt ceilings and paid-call reservations survive redelivery and manual recovery.

cases.arrangement: Only part of the candidate vector set is visible; an old or foreign vector also matches the query.
cases.action: Reconcile desired vectors and retry outstanding intent before candidate promotion.
expected: Incomplete candidate output cannot displace the active set.
Retained pending candidate vectors are not treated as orphans.
Canonical eligibility rejects inactive, deleted, or foreign hits before generation.
Exact-ID receipts distinguish acknowledged writes from verified visibility.

cases.arrangement: Both versions and a complete multi-document answer exist; deletion is admitted with no active processing.
cases.action: Interrupt exact-object/vector cleanup, redeliver, and race a historical-source read.
expected: PURGE_PENDING immediately denies catalog, new research, and historical-source access.
Interrupted cleanup remains pending and can only target the selected document's exact resources.
Completion requires verified external absence and atomic canonical purge.
Complete affected answers are removed, unrelated documents preserved, and costs stay counted.
A used-key content-free tombstone conflicts with replay after purge and cannot recreate content.

cases.arrangement: An inherited schema contains captured, leased, completed, failed, and deletion-pending runs plus a known citation.
cases.action: Upgrade, then query/retry using correct, unknown, and foreign workspace identities.
expected: Only eligible unclaimed CAPTURED work receives initial outbox intent.
No fabricated per-stage attempts, revived failed work, or cleared live leases.
Citation IDs, exact bytes, Unicode offsets, source dates, and costs are unchanged.
Unknown and foreign public results are indistinguishable.
